summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle unrelated to datepicker purpose
details: The package is published under the @ornikar scope and self-describes as a fork of Kiarash-Z's react-modern-calendar-datepicker, but the tarball adds a preinstall hook not present upstream. package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`; setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a ~727KB sibling bundle carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and string-array + control-flow obfuscation (shuffled numeric/string constant array with a rotator function, single-letter mangled identifiers, hex-escaped literals). Fetching a second language runtime at install time to execute a heavily obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based inspection and has no relationship to a React datepicker's advertised functionality. The obfuscated payload runs on `npm install` with the installer's user privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
